headlines.title: CORSAIR PRO to Optimize Engineering Workstations, Servers and Clusters for Ansys Simulation
headlines.summary: MILPITAS, Calif., November 13, 2026--Corsair Gaming, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRSR) ("Corsair" or the "Company"), a leading global provider and innovator of high-performance products for gamers, streamers, content-creators, performance PC builders, and SIM Racing enthusiasts, has joined the Ansys Technology Partner Program, part of Synopsys, to deliver HPC systems that accelerate and simplify deployments.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Synopsys (SNPS) on Nov. 11
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $10.1 million of Synopsys stock on Wednesday, Nov. 11.

headlines.title: Is Synopsys (SNPS) A Bargain Following Its European Chip Design Platform Deal?
headlines.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) just struck an agreement with the European Chips Joint Undertaking to feed its design software into the new European Chips Design Platform, opening institutional access for younger semiconductor outfits. Against that backdrop, Synopsys shares trade at US$462.69, with a 7 day share price return of 5.1% and a 90 day share price return of 9.8%, pointing to firming momentum even though the 30 day share price return declined 6.

headlines.title: Synopsys (SNPS) Joins European Chips Design Platform For Startups And Mid Sized Firms
headlines.summary: Synopsys (NasdaqGS:SNPS) has entered an agreement with the European Chips Joint Undertaking to support the European Chips Design Platform. The collaboration targets startups and medium-sized semiconductor firms that need access to advanced electronic design automation tools for chip development. The program is intended to back work on AI, high-performance computing and photonics within the European semiconductor ecosystem.

headlines.title: Can AI-Driven EDA Accelerate Synopsys' Next Growth Phase?
headlines.summary: SNPS is advancing AI-powered chip design and verification, expanding EDA capabilities and integrating Ansys as rising demand supports its next growth phase.

description: Synopsys, Inc. provides design IP solutions in the semiconductor and electronics industries. It operates in two segments, Design Automation and Design IP. The company offers Digital and Custom IC Design solution that provides digital design implementation solutions; Verification solution that offers virtual prototyping, static and formal verification, simulation, emulation, field programmable gate array (FPGA)-based prototyping, and debug solutions; FPGA design products that are programmed to perform specific functions; synopsys technology computer-aided design (TCAD), mask synthesis, and manufacturing analytic solutions; and AI-driven EDA solutions. It also provides pre-verified and silicon-proven IP solutions, logic libraries and embedded memories, processor and security solutions, IP Offerings for the automotive market, SOC infrastructure IP, data path and building block IP, and mathematical and floating-point components. Synopsys, Inc. has a strategic collaboration with Arm Holdings plc for development of AGI CPU that provides solutions across its full-stack design portfolio including EDA, interface IP, and hardware-assisted verification (HAV). It has a strategic partnership with OpenAI to revolutionize the design of semiconductors. Synopsys, Inc. has a strategic agreement with Amazon to accelerate Amazon's custom silicon innovation and advance the development of complex AI-powered products and cloud infrastructure. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
